purpose: Read-only evidence, not runtime configuration. Discover IDs per connected store.

nodes.name: Customers who have purchased more than once
Abandoned checkouts in the last 30 days
Customers who have purchased at least once
Subscribers who opened or clicked on emails often recently but didn’t make a purchase
nodes.query: email_subscription_status = 'SUBSCRIBED' AND (shopify_email.opened MATCHES (count >= 3, date >= -90d) OR shopify_email.clicked MATCHES (count >= 3, date >= -90d)) AND number_of_orders = 0
